query: UPDATE payday_allocations a SET template_id=n.id,title=n.title,section=n.section,position=n.position,kind=n.kind,expense_group_id=n.expense_group_id,expense_group_name=n.expense_group_name,category_id=n.category_id,subcategory_id=n.subcategory_id,category_name=n.category_name,subcategory_name=n.subcategory_name,amount=n.amount,notes=n.notes FROM payday_templates old,payday_templates n,payday_months m WHERE a.household_id=$1 AND old.household_id=a.household_id AND old.id=a.template_id AND old.recurrence_id=$2 AND n.household_id=a.household_id AND n.id=$3 AND m.household_id=a.household_id AND m.id=a.month_id AND m.month > $4
